objective: Every accessibility fault in the lab is found, and found as the rule it is
preconditions: the lab's ground truth names the axe rule each fault trips
input: Each of the 5 accessibility faults, injected one at a time
expected: Each fault produces exactly the rule its ground truth names, at the impact it names — "the scanner found something" is not evidence it finds the right things
detail: 5 fault(s), each producing exactly what its ground truth names
